description: Look up the duty on one Israeli tariff line on a date. HS tariff code: "07.10.210000", "0710210000" or the old 8-digit "07102100". Israel customs import duty read from the official gazette, by code only (no search by product name). Amounts are in ILS. A duty of kind ending in _bounded, or with a min or max, has a floor or cap (for example 12% but not less than 1.27 ILS/kg): a caller that ignores min and max will compute the wrong duty. purchase_tax and surcharge are the table's raw cells, not parsed. VAT is not included. Free trade agreement (preferential) rates are NOT included in the general-duty reading (preferential_rates_included is false); agreement_tags only names agreements mentioned on the line. status is "verified" when confidence is "high". An origin answer with a source-reviewed preferential option has status "options_only" (see get_tariff_line). Otherwise it is "needs_review" when confidence is "low" (review_reasons is non-empty): some gazette instruction touching the line could not be applied, the duty text could not be parsed, a check digit failed, or an annual amount reading needs its next update. annual_update_required means the annual general-duty reading has passed its verification year. A year-end valid_to before that held continuation is a source verification horizon, not a statutory expiry of the code or duty. The held continuation remains found:true; no earlier rate is substituted. For a general-rate needs_review line duty, purchase_tax and surcharge are null and the reading we have is in unverified_reading: do not rely on it, check the gazette issue and page in source. needs_review answers are not charged; a history containing any needs_review version is not charged. For get_tariff_history status and unverified_reading are on each element of versions, not on the top-level object. found:false NEVER means the duty is zero (a fully exempt line is found:true with duty.kind "free"): not_found.reason says whether the code is not in the tariff, is not yet in force, has ended, or has no applicable version on that date. Renumbering: replaced_by (for an ended code) and replaces (for a new code) list the other code(s), the date and the gazette issue and page, exactly as the gazette states them; kind is one_to_one, split (one old code, several new), merge (several old codes, one new) or group (a whole subtree was rewritten: the old code is replaced by that group of codes, not equal to any one of them). An ended code with no replaced_by has no successor stated in the gazette (not_found.successor says so); none is guessed. A suppression window means a temporary instruction stands in for the permanent codes, named in temporarily_replaced_by. The data runs through gazette issue data_through_issue, and history starts on 2017-01-01. Not legal or customs advice. date is YYYY-MM-DD (default today in Israel). origin_country is the goods' ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of origin, not the shipping country. Origin-specific rates and quotas are conditional on eligibility and documentation; the country alone does not establish entitlement. The general_rate is the separate general reading; country_treatment lists sourced options and import levies. An origin-aware answer includes general_rate only when that reading needs review; request without origin for a verified general rate. conditional_duty_scenarios are hypothetical customs-duty components under stated assumptions, not payable or final duties; other measures remain separate. Scenarios require a country-scoped preference rule that requires qualifying origin; wildcard and no-origin rules remain options only. Canada preference rules carry an audit field marked withhold, so they remain options and do not produce scenarios. A matching preference coverage row with `complete` other than true or malformed/nonempty `review_reasons` suppresses a scenario and adds preference_coverage_unusable; missing coverage remains an unresolved assumption. An origin answer is charged only when the line is verified and it returns at least one source-reviewed preferential option with no overlapping or unverified preference, quota or levy rule, no failed quota audit and no unusable coverage (status "options_only"; confidence high means the options are source-reviewed, not that the shipment qualifies); it never asserts entitlement, quotas, levies or a final shipment duty, whose gaps stay in review_reasons. An origin answer with no such option is status needs_review and is not charged.

origin_country.description: Goods' country of origin, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. US), not shipping country

name: get_tariff_line
